mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with quetiapine (antipsychotic with adrenergic properties) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis due to inhibition of monoamine metabolism and quetiapine's sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, initiate phenelzine at least 2 weeks after quetiapine discontinuation or use alternative antipsychotic with lower sympathomimetic activity under specialist supervision.
